name: Ghatkopar Cloth Stores (P) Ltd
description:
Ghatkopar Cloth Stores (GCS) opened its doors in the year 1958. The founder, Mr. Mukund Mehta, launched the business to sell quality fabric and mill saris. In 1981, the business took a specialized form, selling only one product – saris – but in an unmatched variety.

Over time, the owners learnt about the gross cruelty borne by innocent silkworms to derive raw material for silk saris. 9,000 of these poor creatures are boiled alive to extract silk for a single sari!

Unwilling to be instruments of this mass massacre, GCS chose compassion instead. In a strategic decision, we decided to deal only in ahimsa silk saris. The year was 2006, and we stay true to our commitment towards compassion to this day.

featured_reviews.name: Avinash Godse
featured_reviews.review_text: This is good store for suits and formal wear. Recently got a suit for ML and she looked amazing in that, we both loved the suit. It was very easy to browse through the collection and buy. The staff is very helpful, as one of them arranged a specific sized shirt in no time. Good memorable experience...

featured_reviews.name: Ilina Banerjee
featured_reviews.review_text: It's always a very nice experience to shop from Van Heusen. They gave a great collection of clothes with very comfortable fabrics. However there was a big sign board of discount at the door this time but discounts were only on very few clothes kept in the front in a table in a very unorganised manner. The clothes didn't seem to be of good quality. But apart from those very few discounted items other products were very good as always.

featured_reviews.name: Shrikant Bhongade
featured_reviews.review_text: Very bad experience this time, visited Rcity mall location after my work in tired atire; one of staff called me bhai bhai in weird and no business manner. Left the place without purchasing. Yet 5 star for my old purchases with brand. Tc

featured_reviews.name: ITIKA KAUSHIK
featured_reviews.review_text: This store is located in R City mall, Ghatkopar. This store has a vast variety of formals and casual clothes for men. If you are looking for the office wear clothes like formals, semi formals, business suits and party wear suits for men then you can visit this store they have good variety. They also have men's accessories like belts , tie , cufflinks shoes, handkerchief etc. They have a trial room in the store. The staff is helpful.

featured_reviews.name: Nidhi Dave
featured_reviews.review_text: This store is located in R city Mall, ghatkoper. There have wide range of collection for men and women formal wear. I liked the collection here however had difficulty finding the size as the stock was not maintained. Will recommend this place for formal shopping.

featured_reviews.name: Gauri Sarda
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is a review for the store and not the brand - found the people to be extremely rigid and unhelpful. For trouser alteration they took 8 days. Despite all the requests they gave the trouser after 8 days. It is difficult to understand how altering trousers takes 8 days…!

Also, small store with most styles unavailable and AC never works.

featured_reviews.name: Archie
featured_reviews.review_text: Specifically about the Rcity - Ghatkopar store - Limited collection. No discounts. Staffing are well-groomed but they lack in giving service to the customers coming in. People have to call the staffs and ask for help. One can try looking for options in LifeStyle (Ground Floor) for the same brand. I purchased most of my Van Heusen formals from LifeStyle with good discounts.

featured_reviews.name: Aniket Pagare
featured_reviews.review_text: The best and most premium clothes are available here. Their management is really good. Prices may me high but quality of the product are also good.
